abstract: Primary malignant tumours of the mediastinum are difficult clinical problems in thoracic surgery from both diagnostic and therapeutic points of view. Three cases of malignant seminoma of the mediastinum have been documented, thus bringing the total number of cases reported in the literature to 78. A case of metastasis to the subcutaneous tissue in malignant thymoma has been documented. Because of the multiple-cell types of these tumours and their ill-defined extent due to involvement of adjacent structures, surgery is often difficult. Radiotherapy along with chemotherapy has a definit place in their management, either as a primary treatment in inoperable cases or as a supplement to surgery if the condition is operable.
abstract_ja: 縦隔原発悪性腫瘍は、診断と治療の両面から胸部外科において困難な臨床課題である。縦隔悪性セミノーマの3例が報告され、文献上の報告例は合計78例となった。悪性胸腺腫の皮下組織への転移の1例も報告された。これらの腫瘍は多様な細胞型を含み、隣接構造への浸潤により範囲が不明瞭なため、手術は困難なことが多い。放射線療法は化学療法とともに、切除不能例の一次治療として、または手術の補助療法として明確な役割を持つ。
